query: SELECT CASE WHEN $3 THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_sessions WHERE digest=$1 AND user_id=$2 AND expires_at>statement_timestamp()) ELSE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM integration_keys WHERE digest=$1 AND user_id=$2 AND tenant=coalesce((SELECT live_tenant FROM shop_environments WHERE tenant=$4),$4) AND app_id IS NULL AND expires_at>statement_timestamp()) END AS "valid!"
